## Bounded Contexts

_Only populate this section if the system has meaningful autonomous areas with distinct models._
_A single-context system can omit this section entirely._

<!--
### ContextName

**Purpose**: what this context is responsible for
**Owns**: what data and logic lives here
**Language note**: if any terms mean something different here than in other contexts, note it

**Relationships**:
| Other Context | Relationship | Direction | Notes |
|--------------|-------------|-----------|-------|
| OtherContext | Customer-Supplier / ACL / Partnership | upstream / downstream | |

Relationship types:
- **Partnership** — contexts evolve together, coordinated changes
- **Customer-Supplier** — upstream supplies, downstream consumes
- **Conformist** — downstream adopts upstream's model as-is
- **Anti-Corruption Layer** — downstream translates upstream's model into its own
- **Shared Kernel** — small explicitly shared subset
-->
